name: Practiced Paddler (Racial)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Paddler Shoony

Benefit(s): You’re skilled at navigating bogs and marshes, even for a paddler shoony. You gain a swim speed of 20 feet and the +8 racial bonus on Swim checks that a swim speed normally grants.
